machine.description: The kit's simulated rover (sim-rover): a unicycle, 1.5 m/s and 1.5 rad/s at most, braking at 1 m/s^2.

points.description: The rover's centre, on the floor (z = 0): the point the simulated instrument reports.

notes: The ev03-harness rover envelope (ev03/run.py ENVELOPE), illustrative: a 6 m x 4 m bay with a 1 m x 1 m keep-out (e.g. a stairwell), 0.5 m/s. Frame: the bay's floor, x along its long side, metres; the simulated rover starts at (1, 1) heading +x. The stop and heartbeat values are placeholders: EV-02 has not been run on anything here.
